title: Small-width CNF for a restricted AND of circuits
statement: Let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuits on $n$ variables, let $\rho$ be a restriction on those variables, and let $l$ be a natural number. Suppose that for every circuit $c$ in $cs$, the restricted function $x \mapsto c(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ has decision-tree depth at most $l$. Then there is a CNF formula $\psi$ of width at most $l$ that computes the restriction of the AND of $cs$: writing $g$ for the AND gate applied to the circuits in $cs$, one has $\psi(x) = g(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ for every assignment $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Bool}$.
hypotheses_covered: cs a list of Boolean circuits on n variables
rho a restriction on the n variables
each child circuit's restricted function has decision-tree depth at most l
replaced:
If every child $c \in cs$ satisfies $\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\,c.\mathrm{eval}\,\rho) \le l$,
then there is a CNF $\psi$ of width at most $l$ that computes the restriction of the AND node:
$\mathrm{CNF.eval}\,\psi\,x = \mathrm{restrictFn}\,(\mathrm{eval}\,(\mathrm{node}\,\mathrm{true}\,cs))\,\rho\,x$
for all $x$.
